behaviors.description: Select SDK and debug refs in all four preinstall flag combinations.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent SDK/debug contract refs and one actionable vendor app definition.
behaviors.expected: Every combination installs exactly its selected independent commits, including SDK debug only when both flags are enabled.

behaviors.description: Distinguish dependency suppression from related-ref suppression during preinstallation.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app with separate runtime, app-related extension and runtime extension.
behaviors.expected: No-deps omits the runtime and its extension; no-related retains the runtime but omits related extensions; ordinary synchronization installs the full set.

behaviors.description: Complete vendor installation without input in each automatic confirmation mode.
behaviors.preconditions: Actionable vendor app and empty installation before each variant.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary confirmation refuses with no deployments; each automatic mode installs exact commits without an unanswered prompt.

behaviors.description: Prevent uncached vendor installation with no-pull and contrast ordinary synchronization.
behaviors.preconditions: Actionable vendor definition, initially uncached refs, and independently known commits.
behaviors.expected: No-pull leaves every uncached ref absent; ordinary synchronization immediately afterward installs the full independent ref set.

behaviors.description: Restore a damaged public deployment through explicit vendor reinstallation.
behaviors.preconditions: Independently prepared installed app whose public marker is replaced without modifying repository objects.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary preinstall retains the damaged already-installed payload; explicit reinstall restores the independent original bytes at the same expected commit.

mappings.rationale: Exact independent ref and commit sets distinguish all include combinations.

surface_assertions.rationale: Only SDK-enabled variants install the distinct SDK.
Only debug-enabled variants install debug refs, including SDK debug when applicable.

mappings.rationale: The independently prepared ref graph distinguishes dependency and related-ref policies.

surface_assertions.rationale: Runtime dependencies remain absent while the designated app installs.
Related extensions remain absent while the app and runtime install.

mappings.rationale: Refusal and successful automatic consent produce opposite deployment outcomes.

surface_assertions.rationale: Automatic yes installs the actionable vendor app without input.
Noninteractive synchronization installs without input or an unanswered prompt.

mappings.rationale: An ordinary successful control proves the vendor definition and remote are actionable, while no-pull prevents uncached deployment.

surface_assertions.rationale: No-pull prevents installation of uncached refs that ordinary preinstall subsequently deploys.

mappings.rationale: Independent payload bytes distinguish real redeployment from same-commit no-op synchronization.

surface_assertions.rationale: Reinstallation replaces damaged public payload bytes that ordinary synchronization leaves unchanged.
